description: Wind Pressures for specific Effective Areas
title: Pressures

effArea_press_700.description: DEPRECATED and NO LONGER POPULATED: use mwfrs_press instead. Despite the name this was never a Components and Cladding effective-area pressure. Declared nullable so producers omit it entirely; a consumer generated before mwfrs_press existed will fail loudly on the missing key rather than silently reading 0.0 psf.

effArea_press_1000.description: Components and Cladding pressure in psf at an effective wind area of 1000ft2, per ASCE 7-16 Fig 30.3-2A. Optional: consumers generated before this property existed will not receive it.

mwfrs_press.description: MWFRS pressure in psf, per ASCE 7-16 Fig 27.3-1 for roofs and walls and Sec 27.3.4 GCpn for parapets. Per ASCE 7-16 Sec 30.2.3 this may only be used where the element's ACTUAL tributary area is at least 700ft2, never based on effective wind area. Optional: consumers generated before this property existed will not receive it.
